title: Admiral meeting at a cemetery at midnight

tellings.quote: "So what's going to happen is he he is going to come off of the ship with a cover story of visiting a deceased friend. We need you to meet at a cemetery at midnight.

plain: Brent Friedman, a Hollywood screenwriter, told podcast host Jesse Michels that in 1996 a contact he calls JC set up a secret meeting with a Navy admiral near Long Beach Harbor in California. He says he was told the admiral would leave his ship with a cover story of visiting a dead friend, and that Friedman should meet him at a cemetery at midnight. He tells it as part of his account of insiders quietly passing UFO information to people in Hollywood.
